title: Redaction Reviewer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Judge ten lines of captured output as safe to publish or in need of redaction, and name the category of detail to remove.

educational.topic: Sanitizing Evaluation Artifacts and Publishing the Report
learningObjectives: The learner will judge each of 10 lines of captured output as safe to publish or in need of redaction, and name the category of any detail to redact, with at least 9 of 10 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Line 10 contains an address and a host name and is still safe. Explain what makes it so.
commonMisconceptions: A private address is not identifying.
A serial number or unique identifier is harmless because it grants no access.
A line already shown in a tutorial is safe.
Placeholders and documentation ranges still need redacting.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 9 of 10 correct on the first attempt.

chapter_title: Sanitizing Evaluation Artifacts and Publishing the Report
